text:
The paragraph claims that AES-256 encryption is widely accepted as very secure and nearly impervious to brute-force attacks due to its large key size. This assessment is accurate. AES-256 is a symmetric encryption standard used by governments and industries worldwide to protect sensitive data. Its 256-bit key length provides a massive number of possible key combinations, making brute-force attacks computationally infeasible with current technology. Therefore, the description of AES-256's effectiveness in the text is correct.

Regarding the second part of the text, the famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.
